audience: associations that track members, memberships and event sign-ups in MemberSuite

useCases.title: Find new members and their memberships
useCases.text: Search the individuals who joined this month, then search their memberships for the type, join date and benefit status.

useCases.title: List the registrants of an event
useCases.text: Run an MSQL query on the event registrations of one event, to read the names and the waitlist status of each registrant.

useCases.title: Run a saved search from the Console
useCases.text: List the public saved searches with their IDs, then run one of them to read its records.

useCases.title: Correct the contact details of one person
useCases.text: Find the individual by ID, then update only the fields that changed, such as the email address or phone number. Test writes in a Sandbox first.
